Retoma de onde parou: Pick up where you left off
A tarefa fica guardada. Se o computador: The task is saved. If your computer shuts down or you stop, the next run picks up what’s left without redoing what’s already done.
O agente executa uma tarefa por vez. Deu: The agent runs one task at a time. If it works, the response goes to feito; if there’s an error, it goes to falhou with the reason for you to check.
Nos fluxos que importam, o bot escreve e: For workflows that matter, the bot writes and stops. You read it, make edits if needed, and only then approve it. That’s when you manage instead of doing the work yourself.
